cards.name: Thunder Drum
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that increases weapon drops.

cards.name: Power Bracelet
cards.text: Moves boulders and grave stones and destroys Armos statues, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Any Instrument of the Sirens
cards.text: Any of the eight Instruments banishes the Nightmare over a square. Each one used for the first time adds to the Egg Counter; with all eight, the Wind Fish wakes.

cards.name: Grandpa Ulrira
cards.text: Answers phones, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Magic Powder
cards.text: Lights torches, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.

cards.name: Surf Harp
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that increases experience earned.

cards.name: Organ of Evening Calm
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that increases Material drops.

cards.name: Coral Triangle
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that increases the amount of Food found.

cards.name: Conch Horn
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that reduces the damage a Warrior takes.

cards.name: Sea Lily Bell
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that maxes the Magic meter.

cards.name: Wind Marimba
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that increases Rupees gained.

cards.name: Full Moon Cello
cards.text: Eliminates Nightmares,increases the egg counter and, activates a Siren Power that maxes the Special Attack Gauge.
